description: Installs a real Eclipse Temurin JRE pkg, plus stand-ins for Oracle's Java 8 plug-in and updater, a JRE bundled inside an app, and a Homebrew-style symlinked JDK. Proves Report changes nothing, the keep list keeps, Remove removes the JRE, its package receipt and Oracle's leftovers, and that the bundled JRE and the symlinked JDK are never touched. Also checks the UDF lands in the agent's values.xml as valid XML. Bad input is refused and a second run is harmless.

steps.label: A keep term under 3 characters is refused
Set up: real Temurin JRE, Oracle plug-in and updater stand-ins, an app-bundled JRE, a symlinked JDK
steps.run:
set -e
case "$(uname -m)" in arm64) a=aarch64 ;; *) a=x64 ;; esac
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/temurin.pkg "https://api.adoptium.net/v3/installer/latest/21/ga/mac/$a/jre/hotspot/normal/eclipse"
installer -pkg /tmp/temurin.pkg -target / >/dev/null
ls -d /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-21.*
pkgutil --pkgs | grep '^net\.temurin\.'
P='/Library/Internet Plug-Ins/JavaAppletPlugin.plugin'
mkdir -p "$P/Contents/Home/bin" '/Library/Application Support/Oracle/Java'
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Add :CFBundleVersion string 1.8.431.10' "$P/Contents/Info.plist"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Add :Label string com.oracle.java.Java-Updater' /Library/LaunchAgents/com.oracle.java.Java-Updater.plist
mkdir -p /Applications/TCTestApp.app/Contents/Resources/jre/bin
touch /Applications/TCTestApp.app/Contents/Resources/jre/bin/java
mkdir -p /opt/tc-test/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home/bin
ln -s /opt/tc-test/openjdk.jdk /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/tc-test-openjdk.jdk
echo SETUP_OK

steps.label: Report lists the JRE and the plug-in, leaves the symlink, changes nothing
Report wrote valid XML with the summary and changed nothing
steps.run: xmllint --noout /var/root/.mono/registry/LocalMachine/software/centrastage/values.xml && grep 'name="Custom250"' /var/root/.mono/registry/LocalMachine/software/centrastage/values.xml && grep -q 'Java: FOUND' /var/root/.mono/registry/LocalMachine/software/centrastage/values.xml && ls -d /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-21.* && test -d '/Library/Internet Plug-Ins/JavaAppletPlugin.plugin' && echo REPORT_OK

steps.label: Remove with usrKeep temurin keeps the JRE, removes the plug-in, leaves Oracle leftovers
Kept JRE and its receipt are still there
steps.run: ls -d /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-21.* && pkgutil --pkgs | grep -q '^net\.temurin\.' && test ! -e '/Library/Internet Plug-Ins/JavaAppletPlugin.plugin' && test -e /Library/LaunchAgents/com.oracle.java.Java-Updater.plist && echo KEEP_OK

steps.label: Remove with no keep list removes the JRE, its receipt and Oracle's leftovers
Java is gone; the app-bundled JRE and the symlinked JDK are untouched
steps.run: ! ls -d /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-21.* 2>/dev/null && ! pkgutil --pkgs | grep -q '^net\.temurin\.' && test ! -e /Library/LaunchAgents/com.oracle.java.Java-Updater.plist && test ! -e '/Library/Application Support/Oracle/Java' && test -e /Applications/TCTestApp.app/Contents/Resources/jre/bin/java && test -L /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/tc-test-openjdk.jdk && test -d /opt/tc-test/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home && echo ALL_GOOD

steps.label: UDF updated in place, still valid XML, one Custom250 entry
steps.run: xmllint --noout /var/root/.mono/registry/LocalMachine/software/centrastage/values.xml && test "$(grep -c 'name="Custom250"' /var/root/.mono/registry/LocalMachine/software/centrastage/values.xml)" = 1 && grep -q 'Java: NONE' /var/root/.mono/registry/LocalMachine/software/centrastage/values.xml && echo UDF_OK

steps.label: Tier 2: on an internal Mac with a real Datto agent, the Report summary appears in the UDF on the device page after check-in
